methodology.exitExecution: target/stop price when candle high/low reaches level
methodology.maxHold: configuration-specific; time-limited runs exit remaining quantity at the close of the first candle at or after the holding-period deadline; if a stop or target is reached on that same candle, the stop/target event takes precedence; unlimited runs have no time limit
methodology.feeDefinition: 0.1% of actual monetary value of each buy or sell. Partial sale fees use actual sale value.
methodology.capitalDefinition: sum of remaining quantity multiplied by each position's original entry price
methodology.minimumStartingCashDefinition: minimum initial cash required so the historical cash balance never becomes negative after buys, fees and sale proceeds
methodology.equityDefinition: cash balance plus mark-to-market value of all remaining open quantities
methodology.profitFactorDefinition: gross positive net P&L divided by gross negative net P&L for completed positions only; end-of-data positions are excluded
methodology.timeWeightedReturnDefinition: final equity divided by initial starting cash minus one; there are no external cash flows after inception
methodology.openPositionValuation: remaining quantity marked to the last observed close
methodology.openPositionExitFee: no hypothetical exit fee is charged at end of data
methodology.optimisation: signals calculated once per market; stop/target exits found by segment-tree first-crossing searches; holding-period deadlines found by binary search; portfolio events merged from sorted per-market streams; chronological mark-to-market uses a market-level heap
methodology.portfolioAlgorithm: transaction event k-way merge plus market-level chronological mark-to-market heap
methodology.accountingInvariant: final equity = minimum starting cash + realised net P&L + unrealised gross P&L
